handedness: right (assumed; the ball hooks right-to-left into the rack from the right side)
board_convention: 1-39 counted from the RIGHT gutter (right-hander's convention), read at the last on-lane frame before pin contact
camera: Meta glasses, first person: looks down during the approach, head comes up after release; camera drifts ~2-3 px/frame left while the ball rolls
release_uncertain: +-1: ball in hand at the frame bottom at 414, rolling free with the hand above it at 416
pin_hit_uncertain: +-2: ball at the rack front 477-479 (overlapping the pin bases from 479), among the pins and dim at 481, hidden at 482

lane.description: The lane in the left-centre of the frame after the head comes up; its pin deck sits immediately LEFT of the '40 41' masking label (lane 40 by the label reading, uncertain). Pin bases at y~609 at frame 476 (pins plus their reflection on the deck read as 584-636).

edge_lines.note: x = a*y + b, fitted to per-row wood/gutter steps over the near lane, pin end extrapolated

board_reads.note: edges at the ball row from the frame-479 edge lines (408.1, 493.6); pin ruler 7-column spread 61 px = 36 in; at the pin row the lane is 79.9 px by edges vs 70.3 px by the pin ruler; uncertainty is max(half the spread, 0.5 for the ball-centre reading)

truth_method: Ball centres/radii read by eye on 3x gridded crops (20 px grid) of the source video, each confirmed against a purple/dark blob fit drawn as a circle on the crop (YOLO conf 0.1 and an HSV chain as seeds); lane edges from per-row wood-to-gutter steps fitted as straight lines and checked as overlays; pin rows from the pin silhouettes (pin top + one pin height, reflection excluded); board from the edge profile and the 7-column pin ruler at the last on-lane frame.
